title: Healings and Jesus' Power Over Death

questions.question: When Jesus arrived in the country of the Gerasenes, a man with an unclean spirit met Him. Where did this man live?
options: He lived among the tombs
He lived in a cave in the mountains
He lived in the ruins of an old temple
He lived bound in the city square
questions.explanation: Mark 5:2-3 (ESV): "...there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit. He lived among the tombs..."

questions.question: Why could no one bind the demon-possessed man anymore, even with chains?
options: He wrenched the chains apart and broke the shackles in pieces
He used magic to escape them
He was coated in oil and slipped away
He convinced the guards to release him
questions.correctAnswer: He wrenched the chains apart and broke the shackles in pieces
questions.explanation: Mark 5:4 (ESV): "for he had often been bound with shackles and chains, but he wrenched the chains apart, and he broke the shackles in pieces. No one had the strength to subdue him."

questions.question: When Jesus asked the unclean spirit, "What is your name?", what was the reply?
options: "My name is Legion, for we are many."
"My name is Destruction, for I destroy."
"I have no name that you may speak."
"I am Beelzebul, prince of the air."
questions.correctAnswer: "My name is Legion, for we are many."
questions.explanation: Mark 5:9 (ESV): "And Jesus asked him, 'What is your name?' He replied, 'My name is Legion, for we are many.'"

questions.question: Where did the unclean spirits beg Jesus to send them?
options: Into a great herd of pigs feeding on the hillside
Into a flock of ravens
Into the depths of the sea immediately without hosts
Into a pack of wild wolves
questions.correctAnswer: Into a great herd of pigs feeding on the hillside
questions.explanation: Mark 5:11-12 (ESV): "Now a great herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside, and they begged him, saying, 'Send us to the pigs, let us enter them.'"

questions.question: What happened to the herd of pigs (numbering about two thousand) when the unclean spirits entered them?
options: They rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the sea
They attacked the neighboring herdsmen
They all fell dead instantly in the mud
They scattered deeply into the wilderness
questions.correctAnswer: They rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the sea
questions.explanation: Mark 5:13 (ESV): "...And the herd, numbering about two thousand, rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the sea."

questions.question: When the local people saw the formerly demon-possessed man sitting clothed and in his right mind, what did they ask Jesus to do?
options: They began to beg Jesus to depart from their region
They begged him to heal the rest of their sick
They asked him to pay for the pigs
They wanted to crown him king of the Decapolis
questions.correctAnswer: They began to beg Jesus to depart from their region
questions.explanation: Mark 5:15-17 (ESV): "...And they began to beg Jesus to depart from their region."

questions.question: What did Jesus tell the healed man to do when the man begged to go with Him?
options: "Go home to your friends and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you."
"Follow me and become a disciple."
"Go to Jerusalem to show the priests."
"Go to the desert to cleanse your soul."
questions.correctAnswer: "Go home to your friends and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you."
questions.explanation: Mark 5:19 (ESV): "And he did not permit him but said to him, 'Go home to your friends and tell them how much the Lord has done for you...'"

questions.question: After crossing the sea again, one of the rulers of the synagogue named Jairus fell at Jesus' feet. Why?
options: His little daughter was at the point of death, and he wanted Jesus to lay His hands on her
He wanted to apologize for the Pharisees' behavior
He wanted Jesus to heal his blindness
His wife was possessed by a demon
questions.correctAnswer: His little daughter was at the point of death, and he wanted Jesus to lay His hands on her
questions.explanation: Mark 5:22-23 (ESV): "Then came one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name... 'My little daughter is at the point of death. Come and lay your hands on her, so that she may be made well and live.'"

questions.question: On the way to Jairus' house, a woman touched Jesus' garment. How long had she suffered from a discharge of blood?
options: Twelve years
Seven years
Eighteen years
Three years
questions.explanation: Mark 5:25 (ESV): "And there was a woman who had had a discharge of blood for twelve years,"

questions.question: What had the woman with the discharge of blood said to herself?
options: "If I touch even his garments, I will be made well."
"If he only looks at me, I will be cured."
"If I give him an offering, I will be cleansed."
"If I wash his feet, God will have mercy."
questions.correctAnswer: "If I touch even his garments, I will be made well."
questions.explanation: Mark 5:28 (ESV): "For she said, 'If I touch even his garments, I will be made well.'"

questions.question: Why did Jesus turn around in the crowd and ask, "Who touched my garments?"
options: Because He perceived in Himself that power had gone out from Him
Because someone tore His cloak
Because His disciples told Him a sick woman was behind them
Because the Holy Spirit told Him a demon was present
questions.correctAnswer: Because He perceived in Himself that power had gone out from Him
questions.explanation: Mark 5:30 (ESV): "And Jesus, perceiving in himself that power had gone out from him, immediately turned about in the crowd and said, 'Who touched my garments?'"

questions.question: When the woman fell down before Jesus and told Him the whole truth, what did He say to her?
options: "Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be healed of your disease."
"Woman, you should not have touched me being unclean."
"Your sins are forgiven, go now."
"Blessed are you among women."
questions.correctAnswer: "Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be healed of your disease."
questions.explanation: Mark 5:34 (ESV): "And he said to her, 'Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be healed of your disease.'"

questions.question: While He was still speaking to the woman, people came from Jairus' house and told him what?
options: "Your daughter is dead. Why trouble the Teacher any further?"
"Your daughter has slipped into a coma."
"The scribes will not allow the Teacher to enter your home."
"Your servant has died trying to revive her."
questions.correctAnswer: "Your daughter is dead. Why trouble the Teacher any further?"
questions.explanation: Mark 5:35 (ESV): "...there came from the ruler's house some who said, 'Your daughter is dead. Why trouble the Teacher any further?'"

questions.question: Ignoring what they said, Jesus told Jairus: "Do not fear, only..." what?
options: "...believe."
"...pray."
"...weep."
"...hope."
questions.explanation: Mark 5:36 (ESV): "But overhearing what they said, Jesus said to the ruler of the synagogue, 'Do not fear, only believe.'"

questions.question: Jesus took the child by the hand and said "Talitha cumi", which means what?
options: "Little girl, I say to you, arise."
"Daughter of God, awaken."
"Child, your sleep is over."
"Little one, open your eyes."
questions.correctAnswer: "Little girl, I say to you, arise."
questions.explanation: Mark 5:41 (ESV): "Taking her by the hand he said to her, 'Talitha cumi,' which means, 'Little girl, I say to you, arise.'"

key_verse_text: But overhearing what they said, Jesus said to the ruler of the synagogue, "Do not fear, only believe."
